BrochureContent.Content:
DNG Pierce Properties are delighted to present new to the market Cosher, Kilmuckridge.  A truly magnificent c278 sqm five bedroom detached property situated on c 0.4 acre site only a minutes walk from the heart of the popular coastal Kilmuckridge village in north, Co. Wexford. This lovely contemporary dormer bungalow is presented in pristine condition throughout by its present owners and has been maintained to a very high standard. 

Accommodation comprises of entrance foyer, formal sitting room with feature fireplace, overlooking the front drive. Next we have a wonderful bright and spacious open plan kitchen/dinging/living room, featuring vaulted ceilings with timber beams, two large picture windows at each end and patio doors to the decking area. There is also direct access to the garden room from this area and the living area has a feature fire place with stove. A spacious utility room with back door to the garden and a guest Wc are located off the kitchen. Further along the hallway we have the ensuite master bedroom with a walk through wardrobe. There are two further double bedrooms, one of which is also ensuite. A spacious family bathroom complete the ground floor accommodation.  
On the first floor there the landing has built in units ideal for a home office, there are 2 further double bedrooms, one with the walk-in wardrobe. This floor also has a contemporary shower room. 
This superb property is accessed by a gated driveway to the front with ample parking. The garden set out in lawn with a mature hedge, shrubs and trees and boasts a south west facing decking area complete with garden room which has access to the kitchen, perfect for entertaining.  The property has the advantage of a large workshop measuring c 25 ft x c 45 ft.

Located in the picturesque village of Kilmuckridge and just 4kms to Morriscastle Beach one of the southeast's premier holiday resorts with its long, sandy beach ideal for relaxed scenic walks. 
Wexford, Gorey and Enniscorthy Towns are all within 20 minute drive. This property is inviting from the outset with it's enviable location, architectural design and fabulous space. Early viewing is strongly recommended.
